# Synthetic fixtures

No ASiC fixtures are included in this scaffold.

Future fixtures must be created independently from invented data and covered by
[CC0](LICENSE). Record generator/source, tool version, ASiC variant, signature
profile, purpose, and expected coverage and validation outcome for each fixture.
Never adapt or redact private documents into public fixtures. Generate test keys
at runtime; never commit keys or complete private-key PEM armour lines.
